fact: On 20 August 2026 the National Assembly unanimously adopted projet de loi n°25/2026, which lays down that State data must be kept on national territory, in public infrastructure or with approved private providers, with exceptional hosting or processing abroad, and charges the Autorité nationale de Cybersécurité with supervision.
title: Projet de loi n°25/2026 relatif à la protection des Infrastructures d'Information Critiques (IIC) et à la sécurité numérique
